dossier_meta.catalog_title: Question (Riemannian surfaces): worst surfaces of fixed genus
dossier_meta.statement_text: Which surfaces of a fixed genus are the worst (with respect to the cop number)?
dossier_meta.context_text: Among all Riemannian surfaces sharing the same topological genus, the author asks which geometric realization maximises the cop number, as part of a broader investigation of the continuous Cops and Robbers game on surfaces.
